article.title: Venezuela signs military agreement with U.S. as Hegseth celebrates January 3 attack
article.author: Orinoco Tribune
article.content: Venezuela and the United States signed an agreement to resume military cooperation on Wednesday, November 18, during an unannounced visit to Caracas by U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, whose forces bombed Venezuela and abducted President Nicolás Maduro and First Lady and National Assembly Deputy Cilia Flores less than a year ago. The post Venezuela signs military agreement with U.S. as Hegseth celebrates January 3 attack appeared first on MR Online .
